definition: Heavy and slow-moving, often making a deep regular sound.
author: Leo Tolstoy
quote: He had scarcely read this note, and frowned at its contents, when he heard below the ponderous tramp of the servants, carrying something heavy.
example_sentence: The ponderous lorry crept up the hill.
